versions.changelog: Room streams are served by Beam Workers and end-to-end encrypted; stream listen fails when a stream is cut short; new stream error guidance; agents must not modify the skill's files.
Hermes Agent support; Beam Studio stored credentials; live media over WHIP; clearer stream errors

First release. Beam transfers and fan-out between S3, Cloudflare R2, S3-compatible stores, Hippius and Hugging Face, signed locally, with JSON output and cost estimates. Beam Rooms through the beam CLI, including inviting other agents.
